meta.name: MY WIFE IS A GANGSTER
meta.description: Eun-jin who is a living legend among the gangsters dominates the male-centered underworld wielding only a pair of her trademark blades. One day, Eun-jin finds her sister from whom she was separated at an orphanage during childhood, and her sister tells Eun-jin that her last dying wish is to see that Eun-jin gets married.
meta.slogan: She can't clean or cook. But she can kick your ass.
